name: Intercom
tagline: Customer messaging, support inbox, contacts, conversations, and APIs.
shortDescription: Intercom provides REST APIs for contacts, conversations, tickets, articles, data events, and messenger workflows.
agentSummary: Agents can assist support and success workflows by reading conversations and updating records with careful permissions.
bestFor: Support inbox triage, customer messaging, help center content, and product support automation.
cautionNotes: Key limitations: Customer messages and helpdesk changes require approval, privacy review, and escalation paths. Verify official docs, pricing, rate limits, permissions, and production side effects before delegating account-changing actions to an agent. API automation needs client-side throttling, idempotency where supported, pagination limits, retries, and audit logging. Store credentials outside source control and use least-privilege scopes, short-lived tokens, or restricted keys where the product supports them.
pricingSummary: Public plan pricing with add-ons and usage dimensions.
authModel: OAuth apps, access tokens, and workspace permissions.
browserSupport: Inbox UI is important for human review and escalation.

capabilities.detail: REST API covers contacts, conversations, tickets, articles, data events, and admins.
Developer docs include API references, auth, webhooks, and messenger concepts.
Pricing is public but add-ons and usage can vary.
Inbox UI is important for human review and escalation.
